verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.remote.com returning HTTP 200 with a Remote API documentation index. The docs pages are served as raw .md URLs, which agents can consume directly. Remote also ships agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI, plus a documented MCP server, which add agent-oriented guidance beyond the docs themselves. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually using llms.txt or the markdown docs successfully, and evidence of the llms.txt content depth beyond its header.
